checks.observation: The 49 remaining points have total degree 53, hence excess four. Their falling-factorial sum is at most 20, whereas the relaxed tail allows 13 times 4=52. Thus 2P<=836+20=856, below relaxed U=888; the corresponding score is 4,361 rather than 4,553. The relaxation optimum cannot serve as an attaining family. This local diagnostic neither establishes a universal support-52 bound nor rules one out, matching the manuscript qualification.
